he4_k.qualitative_result: Qualitative scores were processed without changing the received evaluation.

j_k_concordance.statement: All 50 cases passed the preserved structural Top-3 and traceability controls in J, while K marks 28 of 50 as individually auditable under the frozen qualitative threshold. The two controls measure different properties and are not interchangeable.

limitations: The qualitative scoring was performed by an independent AI reviewer operating under the frozen expert-role rubric, rather than by the human review modality originally prepared in the pre-scoring protocol.
